conventions.annualization: 365 calendar days; sample daily standard deviation; risk-free rate zero
conventions.capacity: 1% of eligible-minute base volume; remainder expires
conventions.execution: quote volume divided by base volume in the first full minute beginning at or after submission
conventions.fill_reference_ids: minute-window source references; not individual trade IDs
conventions.fill_time: eligible minute close, after price and volume are known
conventions.hashes: SHA-256; manifest excluded from output_hashes and checked by sidecar
conventions.liquidation_path: no intrabar high/low path; risk uses the last available closed one-minute mark
conventions.mark_gap_estimates: Only 15 documented missing minutes; fixed last official anchor; published at next minute; no additional basis; funding proxy unchanged
conventions.marks: last available closed one-minute mark for signals, risk and valuation
conventions.partial_fills: one native fill event records the executable quantity
conventions.slippage: included in fill; informational attribution never subtracted twice
conventions.synthetic: software validation only; never historical academic results
conventions.terminal_positions: valued without forced close or hypothetical fees

observed_range.source: backtest clock; market-data coverage is in data_coverage.csv
